# The Little AI Company

> Jeff Kazzee builds small AI tools, websites and automations for people and local businesses, and teaches people to build their own on live screen-share sessions. Based in rural Idaho. One person.

## Services
- Live coaching, one-on-one or in groups, over screen share. Half hour $40. One hour $65. Three half hours $100. Small group of 2 to 4: $35 per person per hour. Workshop of 5 to 10: $25 per person per hour.
- Pay for a half hour: https://buy.stripe.com/9B6dR92WvcoZ4Vw8BS08g09
- Book a time after paying: https://calendar.app.google/HnkQMCj9ykUGUhoi6
- Build jobs: websites for local businesses, small tools, automations. Quoted per job, with a written scope and price before work starts.
- Contact: jeff@littleaicompany.com

## Pages
- [Services](services.html): coaching tracks, prices, booking steps, build jobs, questions
- [Work](work.html): Vivary, Callout and smaller projects with their status
- [About](about.html)
- [Start a project](start.html)

## Tools
- [Callout](callout.html): press a hotkey over text on Windows to check it for manipulation signals and check its claims against sources. v0.2.0, released, MIT. Installer: https://github.com/The-Little-AI-Company/callout/releases/latest/download/Callout-Setup.exe
- [Vivary](vivary.html): a desktop workspace for working with AI agents on your own projects. In development, Windows first, not a public release. Site: https://vivaryagent.xyz
